name: project-improvement
description: Improve software, documents and working processes using project evidence and the established workflow.

interface.longDescription:
Improve software, documents and working processes.

Currently includes Review and Improve: a skill that finds worthwhile changes from project evidence, implements and verifies them, and records the results through the project's established workflow. It follows existing project instructions and authorization.
defaultPrompt: $review-and-improve Find one worthwhile improvement, implement it, and verify the result.
